summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of a base prospectus supplement dated 4 August 2026 to its existing base prospectus dated 30 March 2026, as supplemented on 5 May 2026, under its debt issuance programme. The supplement was approved by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and submitted to the National Storage Mechanism. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure for a debt issuance programme, with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic transactions. There are no deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations. This is a standard prospectus supplement notification for fixed-income investors.
